finding: The proposed paid differentiation of interruption-aware project worklogs and local CSV/Markdown export is substantially covered by Tempo Task Tracker. Existing generic timer/history value is also covered by free Pomro. Do not advance Focus Session Desk to paid Store packaging on the current thesis.

sources.name: Tempo official product and pricing
observations: Vendor advertises Windows availability and a Microsoft Store link
Vendor lists EUR 4.99 one-time purchase, without subscription
Local offline project session logs and notes; no account or cloud
Project-level day/week/month/year history; CSV, JSON and Markdown exports
Interruption starts another project and preserves paused original session for resume
Local database backup/restore and selected-note work update export
Vendor explicitly says it is not a Pomodoro countdown
sources.limitations: Vendor claims only; no independent install, user review or purchase verification.

sources.name: Tempo Microsoft Store listing
observations: A concrete Store listing is linked by the vendor
Search/landing preview displays Free download and install
sources.limitations: Listing requires JavaScript to inspect actual pricing, reviews and regional purchase flow; vendor EUR 4.99 versus Store landing Free download is unresolved. Do not treat either as verified checkout price.

sources.name: Pomro official Windows timer
observations: Free and ad-free Windows Store timer according to vendor
25/50 minute presets, local activity/session history and today statistics
Offline, no account or cloud, restart recovery and compact always-on-top mode
sources.limitations: Vendor claims not independently installed or reviewed.

sources.name: PomoCare official Japanese-language timer
observations: Free no-registration timer advertised for Windows and web
Labels, per-task statistics and configurable timer
Local browser storage without login may be cleared; optional free account sync
sources.limitations: Vendor claims only; Windows native/offline packaging and independent reliability unverified.

feature_parity.candidate: Interrupt and resume work while preserving context
One-screen Japanese interrupted-session reason and printable task worklog

remaining_validation: Verify actual Tempo Microsoft Store checkout price and dated reviews in Japan and Germany without guessing from JavaScript-only page.
Independently install and task-test Tempo, Pomro and Focus Session Desk on Windows at 1024x768, in EN/JA.
Collect at least 10 directly linked and dated Microsoft Store review complaints across relevant competitors.
Interview at least five prospective buyers; blind-compare full interrupted-worklog tasks, completion time, export usability and error rates.
Require two demonstrated advantages over free alternatives, a review complaint solved, a credible one-sentence why-pay, and >=80/100 before any MARKET_FIT_PASS.
scope_note: Supplemental research only; does not alter the canonical market-fit score or authorize source changes, Identity binding, MSIX or submission.
